summary: The committed change addresses all five task requirements without an actionable defect.

evidence: scripts/admin-models.ts validates printable-ASCII tokens, redacts tokens from request/HTTP error output, removes URL credentials, enforces HTTPS for tokenized non-loopback endpoints, and adds loopback hosts to both proxy-bypass variables.
tests/admin-models-script.test.ts covers invalid-token redaction, request-error redaction, loopback NO_PROXY handling, and uses fileURLToPath for the child-process working directory.
README.md now documents the previous and current HTTP-error behavior.
